result.summary: The pedestrian environment is a wide commercial arterial featuring a high-visibility continental crosswalk and a grass median refuge. While basic infrastructure like curb ramps and sidewalks are present, the multi-lane configuration and wide road geometry suggest a high-speed environment with significant pedestrian exposure.

hazards.name: Long crossing distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross multiple lanes of traffic, increasing exposure time to vehicles.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground, across the main roadway

hazards.name: High-speed road geometry
hazards.description: Wide, straight lanes and a lack of traffic calming measures encourage higher vehicle speeds.
hazards.location_in_image: Main roadway stretching into the background

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs to reduce the crossing distance and improve sightlines between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Hardscaped Refuge Island
interventions.description: Upgrade the grass median to a raised, paved pedestrian refuge with a cut-through to provide a safer waiting area.

interventions.title: Pedestrian-Scale Lighting
interventions.description: Add lower-height lighting specifically for the crosswalk area to improve nighttime visibility.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment is characterized by a wide, multi-lane intersection with long crossing distances and a high-speed right-turn slip lane. While some sidewalks and a marked crosswalk are present, the infrastructure is discontinuous and lacks sufficient protection for pedestrians crossing the expansive roadway.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross multiple lanes of traffic at the main intersection without a refuge island.
hazards.location_in_image: Center and right side of the intersection

hazards.name: High-Speed Slip Lane
hazards.description: The right-turn slip lane allows vehicles to maintain higher speeds while turning, increasing risk at the crosswalk.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median or refuge island to allow pedestrians to cross the wide roadway in stages.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Add bulb-outs to reduce the crossing distance and slow down turning vehicles.

interventions.title: Slip Lane Redesign
interventions.description: Tighten the turn radius or eliminate the slip lane to force slower vehicle speeds and improve pedestrian visibility.

result.summary: The intersection features a wide multi-lane roadway with a grassy median and marked crosswalks on one side. However, the pedestrian environment is compromised by discontinuous sidewalks and a lack of visible pedestrian-specific signals.

hazards.name: Missing Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: No dedicated pedestrian signal heads are visible, forcing pedestrians to rely on vehicular signals.

hazards.name: Discontinuous Sidewalk
hazards.description: The sidewalk appears to end abruptly or is not connected to a larger network, forcing pedestrians onto unpaved surfaces.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Signal Installation
interventions.description: Install pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers at all crossing points.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Completion
interventions.description: Extend and connect sidewalks to ensure a continuous path of travel to and through the intersection.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Upgrade existing transverse markings to high-visibility continental markings.

result.summary: The image shows a large, car-centric intersection with multiple lanes and long crossing distances. While a sidewalk and curb ramp are present in the foreground, the overall environment lacks robust pedestrian protection like high-visibility markings or refuge islands.

hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross multiple lanes of traffic, increasing exposure time to vehicles.

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalk Markings
hazards.description: The existing crosswalk markings are worn and may not be clearly visible to approaching drivers.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental or ladder-style crosswalk markings to improve visibility.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised island in the center of the wide roadway to allow pedestrians to cross in stages.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install signals that show the remaining time to cross, improving pedestrian decision-making.
